description: UiGuide Agent developer tool: init, scan, bundle, doctor.
UiGuide Agent protocol contracts (v1), shared by the server and the client SDKs.
UiGuide Agent Companion: the help assistant next to any Windows application (Python, Java, Delphi, any exe), without changing it. Windows only.

UiGuide Agent for .NET web UIs: Blazor, Razor Pages / MVC, .NET MAUI Blazor Hybrid. The assistant script as a static asset; the build writes its configuration and knowledge bundle and warns about controls without a name.
UiGuide Agent SDK for .NET desktop applications (WPF and WinForms, .NET 8+ and .NET Framework 4.8).
UiGuide Agent server, ready to run: dotnet tool install -g UiGuideAgent.Server.Host, then uiguide-server.
UiGuide Agent server library: add the AI help agent to any ASP.NET Core application.
Android automation from C# and .NET: test your apps on real phones, script the tasks you repeat and run many phones at once. No ADB, no USB cable, no root.
Shared request, response, and typed-answer contracts for the Rldc decision library.
Decision routing and provider abstractions for applications built on Rldc.
Prepared ONNX and Laya GGUF inference, bundle validation, and model packing for Rldc.
Typed model decisions for .NET apps, with dependency-injection registration and a default ONNX runtime.
Expose Rldc conversational inference through Microsoft.Extensions.AI and Microsoft Agent Framework.
Optional Windows ML execution-provider integration for Rldc ONNX inference.

Lists the prebuilt tools (ffmpeg, ffprobe, zopfli, oxipng, pngout, cwebp, ...) published by meziantou/prebuilt, with their version and SHA-256 checksum, and downloads them to a local cache. The package version is the release version.

Native libraries for ThinkGeo.Gpu on Windows: ANGLE, which runs the engine's OpenGL ES 3.0 on Direct3D 11 and falls back to WARP where no GPU can be had. x64 and x86. Referenced by ThinkGeo.Gpu; an application does not reference it directly.
.NET wrapper of LiteScript, a little script engine to embed in applications (object-oriented language similar to Javascript, assembly language, standard library, saving and loading of states).
NUnit fixtures, bounded frame waits, signal expectations and deferred-deletion assertions for testing real Godot applications with 2dog.
